title: 99. Binary Tree Right Side View

examples.explanation: From the right side, you see the root (1), then the rightmost node at level 2 (3), then the rightmost node at level 3 (4).
From the right side, you see the root (1), then 3 at level 2, then 4 at level 3, then 5 at level 4.
An empty tree has no visible nodes.
